visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A Shiba Inu character, anthropomorphized in an orange polo shirt and a white towel labeled 'Uncle Jojo', sits at a wooden table in a bright living room. It watches a laptop screen showing a black cat in an apron cooking, looking visibly distressed and holding its head. (2) The Shiba Inu's expression turns to one of shock and despair as it clutches its head with both paws. Large white smoke clouds suddenly erupt around the dog, simulating an explosion of frustration. (3) The dog is seen outdoors, happily riding a blue vintage-style scooter through an urban street. It wears a yellow helmet and its mouth is open in a joyful smile. (4) The dog appears inside a rustic chicken coop, holding a large red bowl overflowing with brown eggs. Multiple chickens are seen around its feet and one sits calmly on top of its head. (5) Sitting on the ground outside a metal-shuttered storefront, the dog is shown peeling raw shrimp. There are large piles of unpeeled shrimp on the pavement in front of it. (6) Standing in front of a street food stall with Chinese signage, the dog appears hot and exhausted. It uses its 'Uncle Jojo' towel to wipe sweat from its face and neck. (7) The dog is seen cooking fried rice in a large black wok over a high gas flame. It enthusiastically pours a whole bag of 'AJI-NO-MOTO' MSG into the rice while laughing. (8) Finally, the dog sits at a table inside a restaurant, eating a large spoonful of the shrimp fried rice. It looks at the camera with a satisfied expression and gives a thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM starts immediately. A distinct digital 'click' sound effect triggers as the video begins. (2) A deep male voice lets out a heavy, melodic sigh. In the background, the rhythmic acoustic texture of rapid vegetable chopping is audible. (3) The main male voice shouts a loud, high-arousal 'HAIYAA!!'. This is accompanied by a stylized 'poof' sound effect indicating smoke. (4) The BGM continues over a loud, continuous mechanical drone of a scooter engine. The speaker makes short, joyful vocalizations. (5) High-pitched, repetitive clucking and squawking sounds of multiple chickens dominate this phase. (6) Ambient outdoor market chatter and urban background noise become prominent. The BGM maintains its steady electronic beat. (7) The sound of deep breathing and exhaling is heard over a distant hum of city traffic. (8) A loud, broadband sizzling sound of frying food takes over. It is accompanied by the percussive rattle of a spatula in a metal wok and the rustle of a plastic bag being emptied. The speaker laughs loudly. (9) Wet, rhythmic chewing sounds are followed by a bright, high-frequency 'ding' bell SFX. The male voice shouts 'FUIYOU!' with a sharp, rising intonation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a parody of the 'Uncle Roger' internet persona, using an AI-animated Shiba Inu character to mock poor cooking techniques seen in mainstream media (BBC) and promoting 'authentic' preparation involving high-effort sourcing and heavy use of MSG.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The brand AJI-NO-MOTO is explicitly featured in a heroic light as the essential 'secret' ingredient poured into the cooking wok by the main character.
